header.title: The Battle of the Bulge
header.hook: Hitler's last gamble in the West, launched in fog and snow.
header.outro: Germany never mounted another major offensive in the West.
header.footnote: Fronts simplified; losses interpolated between sourced totals.

events.title: The attack
events.text: At 05:30 the Germans open fire. Fog grounds Allied aircraft.

events.title: Lanzerath
events.text: 18 US soldiers hold up the SS spearhead all day.

events.title: Malmedy
events.text: SS troops kill at least 84 captured Americans.

events.title: Schnee Eifel
events.text: Two US regiments are cut off.

events.title: Stavelot
events.text: Peiper takes the town; US engineers blow the Trois-Ponts bridges.

events.title: Surrender
events.text: About 7,000 men of the 106th Division surrender.

events.title: Elsenborn Ridge
events.text: The northern shoulder holds.

events.title: Bastogne
events.text: The town is surrounded. St. Vith falls.

events.title: "Nuts!"
events.text: General McAuliffe's reply to a German surrender demand.

events.title: Patton
events.text: III Corps attacks north from Arlon toward Bastogne.

events.title: Clear skies
events.text: Allied aircraft strike; supplies are dropped on Bastogne.

events.title: High-water mark
events.text: German tanks stop about 6 km from the Meuse.

events.title: Celles
events.text: US and British tanks smash the 2nd Panzer Division.

events.title: Bastogne relieved
events.text: 4th Armored breaks through at 16:50.

events.title: Bodenplatte
events.text: A Luftwaffe raid on Allied airfields; heavy losses on both sides.

events.title: Counteroffensive
events.text: The US First Army attacks from the north.

events.title: Withdrawal
events.text: Hitler authorises a pullback from the western tip.

events.title: Houffalize
events.text: The First and Third Armies link up.

events.title: St. Vith
events.text: The 7th Armored Division retakes the town.

events.title: The bulge is gone
events.text: The front is nearly back where it started.
